newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-EBRD TO LEND $23MLN TO BALTCOM GSM.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-EBRD TO LEND $23MLN TO BALTCOM GSM.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) on Wednesday said it has approved a $23 million loan to Baltcom GSM, Latvia's new mobile phone operator.
"The bank is working together with a lawyer and the company to finalise the project and the agreement might be signed in a month's time," an EBRD spokeswoman told Reuters.
The bank said the loan was part of a $67 million project to construct a network on the GSM 900 standard by Baltcom, part-owned by Western Wireless and Metromedia International.

Baltcom, the second licence holder on the Latvian mobile phone market, launched operations earlier this year and said it planned to build a new network in three years, involving an investment of some $50 million.
Competition with the first operator, Latvijas Mobilais Telefons, part state-owned and part by Swedish Telia, has already led to some tariff reductions.
